text: seems fixed. this is the last seam of it to close. look at the outter edge [Image #3] and heres my painting [Image #4] the purple is the inner pocket that forms at the end
resolution: Closed the last corner seam — the thin vertical pocket (the purple sliver) at convex wall corners. The face slabs float faceSlabLiftMeters (12mm) proud of the wall core and never mitered, leaving an open ~22mm channel running the full corner height. Added placedPieceWallEnds (per-end corner-join report: which end joins a perpendicular wall and which side is the exposed corner) and a renderer miter in pieceMeshes: the x-axis wall's outer slab runs THROUGH to the joining wall's slab outer surface while the z-axis wall's slab BUTTS into its inner surface — one through + one butt fills the pocket with caps meeting edge-to-edge and no coplanar faces to z-fight when the two walls are skinned differently. wallJoinSignature now digests the end state so neighbor changes re-render the memoized piece. Verified by box dumps over all corner orientations + Ts + straight runs; 46/46 placed tests; game verify GREEN. Commit 31be83e15.
